title: OversightEvent
description: One oversight-chain summary per gated invocation. Mirrors the TypeScript `OversightEvent` interface in @mnmal-ai/swarm-types (packages/types/src/telemetry.ts). Tracks the worker -> reviewer (-> arbiter -> human) escalation chain produced by packages/oversight.

session_id.description: Session this oversight chain belongs to. Matches SwarmEvent.session_id of the worker call.

worker_event_id.description: The SwarmEvent.id of the worker invocation this chain reviews.

reviewer_event_id.description: SwarmEvent.id of the reviewer's invocation, when the reviewer ran. Absent when reviewer_verdict is "skipped".

reviewer_verdict.description: Reviewer's terminal decision. "skipped" when oversight was disabled or the worker output was empty (pre-review validation).

rejection_reasons.description: Reviewer's listed reasons when reviewer_verdict is "rejected".

retry_count.description: Number of retries the worker performed in response to reviewer rejections. Capped at 3 by policy.

arbiter_involved.description: Whether the arbiter was invoked to break a worker/reviewer deadlock.

arbiter_event_id.description: SwarmEvent.id of the arbiter's invocation, when one ran. Present iff arbiter_involved is true.

arbiter_verdict.description: Arbiter's terminal decision. "escalate" hands the decision to a human.

human_escalation.description: Whether a human reviewer was asked to make the final call.

human_decision.description: Free-form decision text from the human escalation, when one occurred.

human_response_time_minutes.description: Wall-clock time the human took to respond, in minutes.

total_resolution_time_ms.description: End-to-end wall-clock time from worker invocation to terminal chain resolution, in milliseconds.

review_skipped_reason.description: When reviewer_verdict is "skipped", a short reason ("oversight disabled", "empty worker output", etc.).
